name: Git Commit From Plan
description: Stage and commit the exact file set proposed by a validated commit plan artifact.

guardrail_repo.description: Path to the Guardrail checkout that contains the git commit plan wrapper helper

plan_file.description: Relative path to a commit-plan artifact. The plan content is content-hash bound.

message_file.description: Relative path to the commit message file. Must match commit-plan message_file exactly.

steps.description: Load and validate the commit plan, verify exact scope bounds, then stage and commit only the approved paths.

constraints: Commit scope is derived only from commit plan fields and must match all bounds constraints
Plan file and message file are content-hash bound as separate recipe inputs
The wrapper rejects mismatches between plan.message_file and message_file
No push and no additional git mutation flags are allowed through this recipe
Unrelated pre-staged changes must be checked by the wrapper before commit
invariants: The wrapper validates commit plans for bounded path, bounds coverage, and version/kind
The wrapper stages only the commit-plan paths that are in bounds
The wrapper commits with the message file specified by the approved plan
The recipe never invokes git push
